feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no result is stated for it. The candidate changes two things from the best raced design, iteration 8 (score 123.04): sensors widened from x = ±0.030 m to ±0.040 m with 16 mm footprints, and kp raised from 6.0 to 8.0. kd stays at 0.6 and base_speed, ki and line_loss are unchanged. The design is within every contract limit, and the sensor reach (about ±0.056 m including footprint) stays well inside the 0.06 m off-track limit. The rationale is sound on one point: the outer sensors now see the edge earlier. Its 4/3 gain-compensation assumption is only approximate, because the readings are normalised and the array is not linear, so the effective gain may differ from iteration 8. Evidence supports the approach. Oval max_error has stayed at 0.061 to 0.065 across kp 6.0 to 7.0 (iterations 2 to 8), so the edge response, not gain alone, is what limits it. Oscillation has stayed at 0.25 to 0.29 on the oval across kp 6.0 to 7.0 and kd 0.4 to 0.6, so raising kp is not the main jitter driver. Approve it so it races: it tests the one hypothesis not yet tried (sensing reach), there are two iterations left after this one, and a race is the only way to measure the effective gain. After the race, use the telemetry as follows. If oval max_error falls below 0.06 and line_loss_events drop below 1.4, keep this geometry and test base_speed 1.6 for progress. If oval steering_oscillation rises above about 0.3 at kp 8.0, return kp toward 7.0 on this geometry rather than adding kd. If line losses stay at 1 or more at the same bend entries, change line_loss to search_left or search_right, favouring the side the failing bends turn towards. If this geometry scores below 123 with max_error still at or above 0.06, return to the iteration 8 geometry (±0.030 m) with kp 6.0 and kd 0.6.
requested_changes: After the race: if oval max_error is below 0.06 and line_loss_events fall, keep geometry.sensor_positions at x = ±0.040 m and test controller.base_speed 1.6 for progress, since iteration 8 showed max_error near 0.061 to 0.065 under the old reach.

After the race: if oval steering_oscillation rises above about 0.3 at kp 8.0, return controller.kp toward 7.0 on this geometry, not more kd, because oscillation has stayed at 0.25 to 0.29 across kd 0.4 to 0.6 (iterations 3 to 8).

After the race: if line_loss_events stay at 1 or more at the same bend entries (iteration 8: 1.4 oval, 1.3 s-bend, 1.0 slalom), change controller.line_loss from last_direction to search_left or search_right, favouring the side the failing bends turn towards.
